content.short: A decentralized protocol for tokenizing iconic intellectual property like music and art into on-chain RWAs.
content.description:
Aria is a decentralized protocol designed to transform iconic intellectual property (IP), such as music and art, into on-chain Real World Assets (RWAs). It enables creators and rights holders to tokenize their work, allowing investors to purchase liquid shares of cultural assets. This model provides a new way for fans and investors to participate in the success of their favorite artists through royalty distributions.

The platform provides the infrastructure needed for IP-backed assets to thrive in Web3. By bringing cultural works onto the blockchain, Aria creates a transparent and accessible market for intellectual property and global digital ownership.
